arxiv-2011-04745.title: Rate Splitting, Superposition Coding and Binning for Groupcasting over the Broadcast Channel: A General Framework
arxiv-2011-04745.creator: Henry Romero, Mahesh K. Varanasi
arxiv-2011-04745.description: Abstract A general inner bound is given for the discrete memoryless broadcast channel with an arbitrary number of users and general message sets, a setting that accounts for the most general form of concurrent groupcasting, with messages intended for any set of subsets of receivers.

arxiv-2105-04145.title: Radial oscillations and gravitational wave echoes of strange stars with nonvanishing lambda
arxiv-2105-04145.creator: Jyatsnasree Bora, Umananda Dev Goswami
arxiv-2105-04145.description: Abstract We study the effect of the cosmological constant on radial oscillations and gravitational wave echoes (GWEs) of non-rotating strange stars. To depict strange star configurations we used two forms of equations of state (EoSs), viz., the MIT Bag model EoS and the linear EoS.

arxiv-2211-01700.title: Semantic 3D Grid Maps for Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2211-01700.creator: Ajinkya Khoche, Maciej K Wozniak, Daniel Duberg, Patric Jensfelt
arxiv-2211-01700.description: Abstract Maps play a key role in rapidly developing area of autonomous driving. We survey the literature for different map representations and find that while the world is three-dimensional, it is common to rely on 2D map representations in order to meet real-time constraints.

arxiv-2211-09393.description: Abstract Let k k be a field of characteristic 0 0 . For a superspace V = V 0 ¯ ⊕ V 1 ¯ V=V_{\bar{0}}\oplus V_{\bar{1}} over k k , we call the vector ( dim k V 0 ¯ , dim k V 1 ¯ ) (\dim_{k}V_{\bar{0}},\dim_{k}V_{\bar{1}}) the ( ℤ 2 {\mathbb{Z}}_{2} -)graded dimension of V V .

arxiv-2405-03699.title: HCC Is All You Need: Alignment—The Sensible Kind Anyway—Is Just Human-Centered Computing
arxiv-2405-03699.creator: Eric Gilbert
arxiv-2405-03699.description: Abstract This article argues that AI Alignment is a type of Human-Centered Computing. 1 Argument The argument of this very short paper is that the problem academic AI has termed “alignment” is just a type of Human-Centered Computing ( HCC ). HCC is an existing academic field. 1 1 1 HCC contains Human-Computer Interaction ( HCI ).

arxiv-2502-06500.title: Gradient flow of the infinite-volume free energy for lattice systems of continuous spins
arxiv-2502-06500.creator: Ronan Herry , Thomas Leblé
arxiv-2502-06500.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ronan Herry , Thomas Leblé. We consider an infinite lattice system of interacting spins living on a smooth compact manifold, with short- but not necessarily finite-range pairwise interactions. We construct the gradient flow of the infinite-volume free energy on the space of translation-invariant spin measures, using an adaptation of the variational approach in Wasserstein space pioneered by Jordan, Kinderlehrer, and Otto in [ JKO98 ] .

arxiv-2511-06935.title: Observational evidence for a possible link between PAH emission and dust trap locations in protoplanetary disks
arxiv-2511-06935.creator: Nienke van der Marel, Niels F. W. Ligterink, Ryan van der Werf, Milou Temmink, Paola Pinilla, Bin Jia, Quincy Bosschaart
arxiv-2511-06935.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Nienke van der Marel, Niels F. W. Ligterink, Ryan van der Werf, Milou Temmink, Paola Pinilla, Bin Jia, Quincy Bosschaart. Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons (PAHs) are commonly detected in protoplanetary disks, but it is unclear what causes the wide range of intensities across the samples.

arxiv-2601-07240.title: Bias-Aware BP Decoding of Quantum Codes via Directional Degeneracy
arxiv-2601-07240.creator: Mohammad Rowshan
arxiv-2601-07240.description: Abstract We study directionally informed belief propagation (BP) decoding for quantum CSS codes, where anisotropic Tanner-graph structure and biased noise concentrate degeneracy along preferred directions. We formalize this by placing orientation weights on Tanner-graph edges, aggregating them into per-qubit directional weights, and defining a directional degeneracy enumerator that summarizes how degeneracy concentrates along those directions.

pmc-11357538.title: Viral Diversity and Ecological Impact of DNA Viruses in Dominant Tick Species in China
pmc-11357538.creator: Yueyang Yan, Zhangpeng Shi, Cunmin Wang, Zi Jin, Jigang Yin, Guan Zhu
pmc-11357538.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Ticks are blood-feeding ectoparasites that also transmit various pathogens, posing severe risks to human and animal health. DNA viruses play a crucial role in the microbial ecology of ticks, but their distribution and ecological significance remain largely undetermined. Here, we assembled an extensive catalog encompassing 4320 viral operational taxonomic units (vOTUs) from six main dominant tick species in China, of which 94.8% have not been found in any other environment.

pmc-11392227.creator: Miwako Kobayashi, Andrew J. Leidner, Ryan Gierke, Jennifer L. Farrar, Rebecca L. Morgan, Doug Campos-Outcalt, Robert Schechter, Katherine A. Poehling, Sarah S. Long, Jamie Loehr, Adam L. Cohen

pmc-11490677.title: Brain structures with stronger genetic associations are not less associated with family- and state-level economic contexts
pmc-11490677.creator: Camille M. Williams, David G. Weissman, Travis T. Mallard, Katie A. McLaughlin, K. Paige Harden
pmc-11490677.description: We investigate whether neural, cognitive, and psychopathology phenotypes that are more strongly related to genetic differences are less strongly associated with family- and state-level economic contexts (N = 5374 individuals with 1KG-EUR-like genotypes with 870 twins, from the Adolescent Behavior and Cognitive Development study).

pmc-12366582.creator: Michela Nosè, Giulia Turrini, Giulia Muriago, Massimiliano Badino, Doriana Cristofalo, Riccardo Sartori, Federico Tedeschi, Corrado Barbui
pmc-12366582.description: AbstractObjectiveAdolescence is a transitional period marked by psychosocial changes that can impact well-being. Mental disorders before university are linked to dropout and lower employment rates, affecting long-term outcomes. This study examines the psychological well-being of Italian students aged 18–25, exploring factors related to distress.DesignCross-sectional survey.SettingHigh schools and university in Verona, northern Italy.ParticipantsA total of 1766 students (88.

pmc-12420800.title: Integrated acoustic identification of a petit-spot volcanic field in the oldest Pacific plate
pmc-12420800.creator: Shiki Machida, Junji Kaneko, Kazuhiro Inose, Tatsuo Nozaki, Koichi Iijima, Naoto Hirano
pmc-12420800.description: Petit-spot volcanism plays a critical role in the metasomatism of oceanic plates prior to subduction and in their recycling into the deep mantle. The extent of metasomatism depends on the number and volume of petit-spot volcanic edifices and intrusions, making precise identification of petit-spot volcanic fields essential.

pmc-13043033.title: Stressors, mental health and coping amongst forcibly displaced youth since the advent of COVID-19: A systematic review
pmc-13043033.creator: Maureen Seguin, Robin Cavagnoud, Camila Gianella, Taras Khomych, Natalia Vibla
pmc-13043033.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Mental health is a key issue for forcibly displaced youth. The evidence base on the mental health of youth forcibly displaced since the start of the pandemic is undefined, as well as sources of stressors and coping approaches. This systematic review aims to identify literature on the mental health of forcibly displaced youth in low- and middle-income settings, with focus on displacement since the advent of the COVID-19 pandemic.

pmc-13408380.title: Unlocking Potential of Potentilla erecta: Development and Efficacy Evaluation of Oral Mucoadhesive Gel for Oral Ulcers
pmc-13408380.creator: Tamara Rudic, Jovana Bradic, Jasmina Sretenovic, Aleksandar Kocovic, Miona Vuletic, Suzana Zivanovic, Irena Petrusic, Vladimir Jakovljevic, Aleksandra Stojanovic
pmc-13408380.description: Oral ulcerations are complex pathological lesions with multifactorial etiology and diverse clinical manifestations. Current treatment options are mostly symptomatic with a different adverse effect. Therefore, this study aimed to develop a mucoadhesive oral gel containing Potentilla erecta L. ethanol extract (PEOG) and evaluate its healing effects in a rat model of oral ulceration.

pmc-13494617.title: Mature oocyte retrieval without an exogenous trigger during random-start stimulation in a very early intrauterine pregnancy: a case report
pmc-13494617.creator: Mohammad Saaed ElFarran, Karolina Palinska-Rudzka, Raj Mathur
pmc-13494617.description: ObjectiveTo describe a rare case of mature oocyte retrieval without an exogenous trigger during random-start controlled ovarian stimulation (RS-COS) coinciding with a very early intrauterine pregnancy.DesignCase report.SubjectA 32-year-old para 1 patient with inflammatory breast cancer (grade 3, T4N2M0, ER/PR negative, HER2 3+, Ki-67 60%).ExposureLuteal-phase RS-COS using a gonadotropin-releasing hormone antagonist protocol with human menopausal gonadotropin (hMG) 300 IU daily.

pmc-13544750.title: Bilateral forgotten double-j stents with high-grade encrustation (fecal grade 4–5): renal loss and staged multimodal management – a case report
pmc-13544750.creator: Youssef Maachi, Zinedine Omar, Amine Slaoui, Tariq Karmouni, Abdelatif Koutani, Khalid Elkhader
pmc-13544750.description: Introduction and importance:Forgotten ureteral double-J (JJ) stents with high-grade encrustation (FECal grade 4–5) represent a severe and preventable urological complication. We report a case illustrating the catastrophic consequences of a failure of 24-month follow-up, culminating in irreversible renal loss and complex three-stage contralateral management.

pmc-13614800.title: Parental Experiences in Caring for Children with Surgically Treated Hydrocephalus: A Phenomenological Study from Eastern India
pmc-13614800.creator: Susojeeta Goudo, Hepsi Bai Joseph, Kanishka Das, Asha Prabhakar Shetty
pmc-13614800.description: Background:Congenital anomalies may be structural or functional and manifest at birth or be detected later in life. One such condition, hydrocephalus, is commonly managed with a Ventriculo-peritoneal (VP) shunt. As children grow with a shunt in situ, parents play a vital role in recognizing the symptoms of shunt malfunction and reporting for medical care.
